from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485222/attempts/83275b2e45034ad1868f4c57ede5090a/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = {}
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, v in enumerate(row):
            if v in (1, 2):
                points[v] = (r, c)
    r, c = points[1]
    tr, tc = points[2]
    dr = 1 if tr > r else -1
    dc = 1 if tc > c else -1
    nr, nc = abs(tr - r), abs(tc - c)
    diagonal = min(nr, nc)
    # Extend the diagonal from 1, leave the final diagonal step to 2.
    for _ in range(max(0, diagonal - 1)):
        r += dr
        c += dc
        out[r][c] = 3
    if nr > nc:
        for _ in range(nr - diagonal):
            r += dr
            out[r][c] = 3
    else:
        for _ in range(nc - diagonal):
            c += dc
            out[r][c] = 3
    # The remaining diagonal cell(s) are adjacent to point 2; paint all
    # intermediate cells, preserving both numbered endpoints.
    while (r + dr, c + dc) != (tr, tc):
        r += dr
        c += dc
        out[r][c] = 3
    return out
'''
path=base/'task-d86adeee.py'
path.write_text(code)
print(path)
